title: Rules.
bodyText: The director may adopt, amend, and repeal rules necessary or desirable to the implementation of this chapter, subject to the provisions of chapter 91.
bodyHtml: [§319-5]  Rules.  The director may adopt, amend, and repeal rules necessary or desirable to the implementation of this chapter, subject to the provisions of chapter 91. [L 1976, c 132, pt of §2]
